title: Folate therapy and in-stent restenosis after coronary stenting
authors: Lange H, Suryapranata H, De Luca G, Börner C, Dille J, Kallmayer K, et al.
followUp: 6 months of treatment and angiography at 6 months; clinical end points to 250 days
population: Patients after successful coronary stenting in a double-blind multicentre trial led from Bremen, Germany, and Zwolle, the Netherlands
funder: Funded in part by Medice, Iserlohn, Germany. The investigators initiated the study, wrote the article and had full access to the data; data analysis was performed by an independent core laboratory (Diagram).
result: Folic acid 1 mg, vitamin B6 5 mg and B12 1 mg intravenously, then daily folic acid 1.2 mg, B6 48 mg and B12 60 µg orally for 6 months (n = 316), against placebo (n = 320). Among 242 and 241 patients with follow-up angiography, restenosis 34.5% against 26.5% (RR 1.30, 95% CI 1.00 to 1.69; P = 0.05); late luminal loss 0.90 against 0.76 mm (P = 0.004). By 250 days, repeat target-vessel revascularisation in 50 (15.8%) against 34 (10.6%) of all patients (P = 0.05). No discontinuation for side effects. The excess was absent in women, patients with diabetes and those with homocysteine of 15 µmol/L or more.
